goal: Decide whether one text message is likely a scam, likely safe, or uncertain, and explain why in plain words an older adult can understand.

message.text: Grandma I need a favor, can you buy two Google Play cards and text me the numbers? I will pay you back.

explanation: This looks like a scam. The message asks you to pay with a gift card, which is a strong warning sign. It also asks for money, which is a weak warning sign. The sender is a saved contact, but the request seems unusual.
what_to_do: Do not reply, do not tap any link, and do not send money or codes. Call Emma (granddaughter) on the number you already have and ask if they really sent it.
guide_tip: Tip from our guide (G01): Do not buy the card. Hang up or delete the text and call the agency using the number on your card or letter.
